spanish: Y degollará el cordero en lugar que se degüella el pecado y el holocausto, en lugar de la santidad, porque como el pecado la culpa ella al sacerdote; santidad de santidades ella.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3ms active slaughter, with את marking the sin and the burnt offering as objects, is rendered passive/impersonal.
Locative 'in the place of the holiness' is rendered with the current-Spanish substitution idiom 'en lugar de' ('instead of the holiness').
Both pronouns are 3ms; 'ella' is feminine, matching Spanish 'culpa' rather than the masculine token.

notes: The rest tracks the tokens, including repeated קדש and the verbless predicates.
